notes: 503B outsourcing facility in Cary, NC failed to meet section 503B conditions (labeling, adverse-event reporting) and had extensive insanitary/aseptic-processing deficiencies (blocked first air, inadequate gowning/glove hygiene, failed smoke studies, rusty ISO 5 hood) causing sterile drug products like Tirzepatide and Semaglutide injections to be adulterated and misbranded and treated as unapproved new drugs; FDA repeatedly faults the firm for not assessing the impact on already-released/distributed batches.
